crossRefs.note: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to…
He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my…
For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great…
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know…
Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,
lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.
There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This…
I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
Give us today our daily bread.
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.web: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
translations.bsb: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
translations.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be ➔ therewith content.
translations.asv: but having food and covering we shall be therewith content.
